motivation: The independently admitted component candidate improves VGNC and TreeFam F1, but GO similarity decreases by more than the existing 0.005 development screen. GO-assessed relations rise from 84211 to 105070. Diagnose pair-population and native confidence changes before another accuracy experiment.
inputs: Admitted matched control and component own-tree products, their retained GO/EC raw six-decimal pair scores, and native confidence TSVs. Bind raw file counts and means to existing admissions and preserve all prior failures.
operation: Use existing validated scored-pair parsers and descriptive overlap/confidence helpers to decompose GO and EC into shared, added and removed eligible pairs and native high/medium evidence classes. Require shared serialized annotation scores to be unchanged and totals to reproduce admitted metrics within their existing serialization tolerance.
selection: Use localization to choose subsequent label-independent HMM/candidate/tree hypotheses. Do not filter predictions by benchmark annotations, revise official denominators, impute missing values or promote defaults based on this diagnostic.
limitations: Functional similarity is conditional on eligible annotated pairs, not orthology truth.
Decomposition is arithmetic, not causal attribution or an independent-unit confidence interval.
Native evidence labels are not calibrated probabilities or bootstrap support.
All examined datasets remain development-exposed; no new scoring, native inference or uncertainty estimate.
